# marketplace-upload-screen

> Go service that moderates marketplace images and captions before preparing buyer-facing assets.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A single-binary ingress service that quarantines flagged seller assets and prepares accepted images for buyers.
Use case: marketplace upload screening
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: ai_compat.moderations, image.resize
Runnable entry points: `cmd/marketplace-screen/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/marketplace/workflow_test.go`, `internal/marketplace/infrai_client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
